description:
Grab your biggest gun and help one fearless squirrel collect every nut! Shoot, jump, use weapon recoil to launch yourself through obstacles, and blast enemies with nut-shaped heads.

Every level brings new traps, crazy situations, and fresh challenges. Unlock even bigger weapons, master chaotic physics, and turn every firefight into explosive fun.

Features:

- Fast-paced 2D action with ragdoll physics
- A crazy arsenal of powerful weapons
- Use weapon recoil to reach new places
- Nut-headed enemies and deadly traps
- Dozens of action-packed levels
- Easy to learn, endlessly fun to master
